_comment: The ESP32-S3 in the wall box (firmware 3.7.0): three two-channel relay modules, six relays. Copy to data/app/devices.json when the box is wired and the Uno is unplugged. Each id is a relay NAME in the firmware's RELAY_TABLE (aankhen/firmware/config.h) and channel is its GPIO there. The name is also what you say to JARVIS ('pink outer on'); rename freely, keep the ids.
